article.headline: Kaseem Watson, Cian Medley lead East Carolina past South Carolina Upstate 83-70 in opener
article.description: — Kaseem Watson had 17 points and Cian Medley added a double-double to help East Carolina defeat South Carolina Upstate 83-70 on Monday night in a season opener.
article.linkText: Kaseem Watson, Cian Medley lead East Carolina past South Carolina Upstate 83-70 in opener

categories.description: South Carolina Upstate Spartans @ East Carolina Pirates

event.description: South Carolina Upstate Spartans @ East Carolina Pirates

keywords: South Carolina Upstate Spartans @ East Carolina Pirates
article.story: GREENVILLE, N.C. -- — Kaseem Watson had 17 points and Cian Medley added a double-double to help East Carolina defeat South Carolina Upstate 83-70 on Monday night in a season opener. Watson also grabbed seven rebounds for the Pirates. Medley totaled 14 points and 11 assists. Brycen Blaine scored 14 on 5-for-10 shooting with three 3-pointers. Jalyn Patterson finished with 16 points and two steals for the Spartans. Ries Naugle scored 15 and Miles Webb posted a double-double with 12 points and 10 rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
